source.expression:
def forward(self, x):
    q = self.a(x)
    k = self.b(x)
    v = self.c(x)
    scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) / 2.0
    probabilities = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    mixed = torch.matmul(probabilities, v)
    return self.norm(x + self.out(mixed))
